idea-plugin.name: Keymap Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Browse every keymap installed in your IDE and see what it does at a glance.

  • Pick any keymap (built-in or your own) from a drop-down
  • See which operating system it is designed for (macOS, Windows, Linux) and what it inherits from
  • Search actions and shortcuts; show only assigned actions or every action
  • Double-click to change a shortcut: press the keys, and they are translated to the keymap's OS (Ctrl ↔ ⌘)
  • Mouse shortcuts (Ctrl+Click, Ctrl+Double Click…), two-step shortcuts (Ctrl+K, Ctrl+K) and double modifiers (Double Ctrl, Double Shift)
  • Click a shortcut cell to type a shortcut, with suggestions for every key name
  • Resolve conflicts: remove from others, review one by one, keep, or undo
  • Copy a keymap or create a new empty one for macOS, Windows or Linux
  • Export the assigned shortcuts of a keymap to a Markdown file
  • Import and export keymaps as IntelliJ keymap XML files
  • Migrate a keymap to another OS in one step (Ctrl ↔ ⌘ translated)
  • Markdown view grouped by menu (Edit, View, Navigate…)
  • Compact icon toolbar; maximize the tool window or open it in its own (fullscreen-capable) window

Open it from View | Tool Windows | Keymap Viewer.
